name: Ji Zhang
title: Research faculty / Senior Systems Scientist
fitReason: SysNav (March 2026) integrates a vision-language model for semantic room-level decisions with geometric exploration and robot-specific motion control. This is a concrete foundation-model deployment direction within an established robot-autonomy group.

physicalEvidence.summary: SysNav deploys on a custom wheeled robot, Unitree Go2 and Unitree G1, with panoramic RGB and Livox Mid-360 LiDAR. The full paper reports 190 physical episodes, split into 78 qualitative and 112 quantitative trials. The author repository explicitly identifies Ji Zhang’s CMU group as project lead, so this is more than a coauthor-only hardware link.

shortVisit.summary: The inspected personal and official group pages provide professional contact and current students/affiliates but no explicit short external-master’s visitor invitation. Prior visitor participation is only precedent. No summer 2027 route is established and the opportunity score remains zero.

Use Senior Systems Scientist from the current RI faculty directory. The personal and engineering pages retain Systems Scientist wording. Do not relabel the role as Assistant Professor.

SysNav uses Gemini for high-level decisions and classical planning with built-in Unitree locomotion control; it is not a newly trained end-to-end locomotion policy. Hardware has both cameras and LiDAR.

The 190 physical episodes include qualitative examples; they are not all quantitative comparison trials. The project’s revised path-length statistics cover only 78 complete recordings. The G1 hardware is credited to an external provider, so ownership should not be inferred.

The existing CMU institutional supplement supports an overseas-degree Student Intern route with host approval and possible personal funding. That policy does not establish individual faculty capacity, a precise eight-week appointment or 2027 costs.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
